entries.title: A merge card's after-merge steps scroll with its body
entries.body: What happens after a merge now sits at the top of the merge card's body and scrolls away as you read, instead of a box that stayed above the reply field and squeezed the card. Your own steps come first under a label in the warning color, then the steps the crew starts. The phone shows both the same way.

picture.alt: A merge card whose body opens with one panel: your step under an orange label, then the two steps the crew starts, with the reply field and Merge below
